about_the_game:
Maximum Apocalypse: The Video Game brings the acclaimed survival board game to life in a thrilling roguelike adventure. The world has ended in chaos, and survival is all that matters. Navigate a hostile, ever-changing environment filled with zombies, mutants, aliens, and rogue machines as you scavenge for resources, complete missions, and fight to stay alive.

Try the Maximum Apocalypse: The Video Game demo and experience the first taste of survival in a post-apocalyptic world! Play three missions from the Zombie Apocalypse scenario and choose from six unique survivors as you scavenge, fight, and strategize your way to victory.

The full game will feature multiplayer, four apocalyptic scenarios, more missions, and additional survivors—stay tuned for more!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit version only)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 or AMD Ryzen 3 2200G
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 2000 graphics or Vega 8 graphics
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or better (64bit version only)
  • Processor: NVIDIA GeForce 8800 GT (512 MB) or ATI Radeon HD 4850 (512 MB) or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with DX11 or OpenGL 3.x capabilities
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
